question: Q1
objective_or_outputs: Compute the equivalent human temperature T_h(t)
Compute the three layer temperature fields T_i(x,t)
Find the first crossings t15 and t10

variables.name: T_i
variables.meaning: temperature field in clothing layer i

parameters.name: q_pcm
parameters.source: attachment 1 DSC; exothermic negative converted by -1000

equations_or_objective: rho_i c_i dT_i/dt = k_i d2T_i/dx2 + Q_i(T_i)
constraints: temperature and heat flux are continuous at both material interfaces
q_pcm(T)=0 outside the measured attachment interval
initial_or_boundary_conditions: T_i(x,0)=37 degC for all three layers
two material interfaces satisfy temperature and heat-flux continuity
inner and outer boundaries are Robin conditions
data_scope: no DSC extrapolation outside the measured interval
allowed_numerical_freedom: time step and modal truncation chosen by convergence
quadrature order and stable 3x3 linear solver
finite-volume grid and stiff ODE tolerances for the independent baseline
forbidden_silent_changes: change the human heat-capacity model or add metabolic heat
replace either Robin boundary by a fixed temperature
change the DSC sign, unit conversion, measured interval, or outside-range zero rule
drop interface temperature or heat-flux continuity
shrink the simulated model domain for a claimed result
modeler_notes: Primary method is the short-time modal expansion in q1.tex. An implicit finite-volume solution is explicitly retained as an independent numerical baseline.
